data.comment:
# Comfy Seedream 5.0 Flash- Text to Image

Generate high-quality images from text prompts using Seedream 5.0 Flash, producing detailed 1K, 1.5K, or 2K visuals with cinematic lighting and accurate text rendering, saved as a single image output. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_bytedance_seedream_5_0_flash_t2i.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: High-fashion sports magazine editorial video. A powerful athletic runner sprinting forward across the frame against a glowing monochromatic amber-orange studio background. Artistic motion blur trails capturing explosive speed and fluid movement. Minimalist sleek black compression sportswear, no logos. Dramatic rim lighting, deep contrast shadows, dynamic high-impact composition, cinematic 4k aesthetic.
